items.title: Jasper Taylor Interview, 1959-06-30
items.q: I met, uh, I didn't hear T.O. until I came to Chicago. He came up with the first New Orleans Creole band.

ctx.x: When did you first hear or meet T.O.?
I met, uh, I didn't hear T.O. until I came to Chicago. He came up with the first New Orleans Creole band. Uh, that is, uh, the first one I knew about. Yeah, the first one you knew about.
Do you remember who else was in the band? Any of the other fellows?
